name: PINEAPP
recent: PINEAPP 于 2026 年 9 月完成一项私募配售，以每股 RM0.8400 发行 4,850,000 股新股，筹集毛收益 RM4,074,000。该批新股已于 2026 年 9 月 24 日在 ACE Market 上市。近期没有相关新闻。
notable: 完成私募配售，发行 4,850,000 股新股，筹集毛收益 RM4,074,000。
私募配售新股于 2026 年 9 月 24 日在 ACE Market 上市。
Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 8 月 28 日批准最多 4,850,000 股配售股的上市与报价。
risks: 私募配售发行 4,850,000 股新股，占扩大后已发行股本约 9.09%，对现有股东持股比例产生摊薄影响。

recent_en: PINEAPP completed a private placement in September 2026, issuing 4,850,000 new shares at RM0.8400 each and raising gross proceeds of RM4,074,000. The placement shares were listed on the ACE Market on 24 September 2026. There has been no recent news.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 4,850,000 new shares, raising gross proceeds of RM4,074,000.
The placement shares were listed on the ACE Market on 24 September 2026.
Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of up to 4,850,000 placement shares on 28 August 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of 4,850,000 new shares represents approximately 9.09% of the enlarged issued share capital, diluting existing shareholders' stakes.
